summary:
The task was to use the keyboard to open the GOV.UK search menu and look up “passport.”
No CAPTCHA or access challenge was shown.
After navigating with Tab and Shift+Tab, the Show search menu control was reachable by keyboard and was opened.
The Search GOV.UK field appeared, and a search for “passport” was submitted.
The GOV.UK search results page loaded and displayed results for the query.
